method: Kernel correlationId joins uniquely to CUDA runtime. Host NVTX containment uses runtime start/end and globalTid, not GPU timestamps inside CPU ranges. Graph creation timestamps are separately tested for enclosing NVTX.

schemas.StringIds:
CREATE TABLE StringIds (
    -- Consolidation of repetitive string values.

    id                          INTEGER   NOT NULL   PRIMARY KEY,      -- ID reference value.
    value                       TEXT      NOT NULL                     -- String value.
)
schemas.CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME:
CREATE TABLE CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME (
    start                       INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Event start timestamp (ns).
    end                         INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Event end timestamp (ns).
    eventClass                  INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- REFERENCES ENUM_NSYS_EVENT_CLASS(id)
    globalTid                   INTEGER,                               -- Serialized GlobalId.
    correlationId               INTEGER,                               -- ID used to identify events that this function call has triggered.
    nameId                      INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- REFERENCES StringIds(id) -- Function name
    returnValue                 INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Return value of the function call.
    callchainId                 INTEGER                                -- REFERENCES CUDA_CALLCHAINS(id)
)
schemas.CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL:
CREATE TABLE CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL (
    start                       INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Event start timestamp (ns).
    end                         INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Event end timestamp (ns).
    deviceId                    INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Device ID.
    contextId                   INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Context ID.
    greenContextId              INTEGER,                               -- Green context ID.
    streamId                    INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Stream ID.
    correlationId               INTEGER,                               -- REFERENCES CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME(correlationId)
    globalPid                   INTEGER,                               -- Serialized GlobalId.
    demangledName               INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- REFERENCES StringIds(id) -- Kernel function name w/ templates
    shortName                   INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- REFERENCES StringIds(id) -- Base kernel function name
    mangledName                 INTEGER,                               -- REFERENCES StringIds(id) -- Raw C++ mangled kernel function name
    launchType                  INTEGER,                               -- REFERENCES ENUM_CUDA_KERNEL_LAUNCH_TYPE(id)
    cacheConfig                 INTEGER,                               -- REFERENCES ENUM_CUDA_FUNC_CACHE_CONFIG(id)
    registersPerThread          INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Number of registers required for each thread executing the kernel.
    gridX                       INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- X-dimension grid size.
    gridY                       INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Y-dimension grid size.
    gridZ                       INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Z-dimension grid size.
    blockX                      INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- X-dimension block size.
    blockY                      INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Y-dimension block size.
    blockZ                      INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Z-dimension block size.
    staticSharedMemory          INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Static shared memory allocated for the kernel (B).
    dynamicSharedMemory         INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel (B).
    localMemoryPerThread        INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Amount of local memory reserved for each thread (B).
    localMemoryTotal            INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel (B).
    gridId                      INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Unique grid ID of the kernel assigned at runtime.
    sharedMemoryExecuted        INTEGER,                               -- Shared memory size set by the driver.
    graphNodeId                 INTEGER,                               -- REFERENCES CUDA_GRAPH_NODE_EVENTS(graphNodeId)
    sharedMemoryLimitConfig     INTEGER                                -- REFERENCES ENUM_CUDA_SHARED_MEM_LIMIT_CONFIG(id)
)
schemas.CUDA_GRAPH_NODE_EVENTS:
CREATE TABLE CUDA_GRAPH_NODE_EVENTS (
    start                       INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Event start timestamp (ns).
    end                         INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Event end timestamp (ns).
    eventClass                  INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- REFERENCES ENUM_NSYS_EVENT_CLASS(id)
    globalTid                   INTEGER,                               -- Serialized GlobalId.
    nameId                      INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- REFERENCES StringIds(id) -- Function name
    graphNodeId                 INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Graph node ID.
    originalGraphNodeId         INTEGER                                -- Reference to the original graph node ID, if cloned node.
)
schemas.NVTX_EVENTS:
CREATE TABLE NVTX_EVENTS (
    start                       INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- Event start timestamp (ns).
    end                         INTEGER,                               -- Event end timestamp (ns).
    eventType                   INTEGER   NOT NULL,                    -- REFERENCES ENUM_NSYS_EVENT_TYPE(id)
    rangeId                     INTEGER,                               -- Correlation ID returned from a nvtxRangeStart call.
    category                    INTEGER,                               -- User-controlled ID that can be used to group events.
    color                       INTEGER,                               -- Encoded ARGB color value.
    text                        TEXT,                                  -- Explicit name/text (non-registered string)
    globalTid                   INTEGER,                               -- Serialized GlobalId.
    endGlobalTid                INTEGER,                               -- Serialized GlobalId.
    textId                      INTEGER,                               -- REFERENCES StringIds(id) -- Registered NVTX domain/string
    domainId                    INTEGER,                               -- User-controlled ID that can be used to group events.
    uint64Value                 INTEGER,                               -- One of possible payload value union members.
    int64Value                  INTEGER,                               -- One of possible payload value union members.
    doubleValue                 REAL,                                  -- One of possible payload value union members.
    uint32Value                 INTEGER,                               -- One of possible payload value union members.
    int32Value                  INTEGER,                               -- One of possible payload value union members.
    floatValue                  REAL,                                  -- One of possible payload value union members.
    jsonTextId                  INTEGER,                               -- One of possible payload value union members.
    jsonText                    TEXT,                                  -- One of possible payload value union members.
    binaryData                  TEXT                                   -- Binary payload. See docs for format.
)

nvtx_names.sql: SELECT COALESCE(n.text,s.value) AS range_name, COUNT(*) AS ranges, SUM(n.end IS NOT NULL) AS completed, MIN(n.start) AS first_start_ns, MAX(n.end) AS last_end_ns FROM NVTX_EVENTS n LEFT JOIN StringIds s ON n.textId=s.id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

kernel_identity_totals.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS kernels,COUNT(DISTINCT globalPid) AS processes,COUNT(DISTINCT deviceId) AS devices,COUNT(DISTINCT contextId) AS contexts,COUNT(DISTINCT streamId) AS streams,SUM(end-start) AS cumulative_kernel_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL

runtime_identity.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS runtime_events,SUM(callchainId IS NOT NULL) AS available_callchains,COUNT(DISTINCT globalTid) AS threads FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME

runtime_duplicate_correlations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS duplicated_correlation_ids FROM (SELECT correlationId FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME GROUP BY correlationId HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

kernel_runtime_join_coverage.sql: SELECT SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r WHERE r.correlationId=k.correlationId)) AS kernels_with_runtime,COUNT(*) AS kernels FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k

kernel_runtime_functions.sql: SELECT s.value AS runtime_name,COUNT(*) AS kernels,COUNT(DISTINCT k.correlationId) AS correlations,SUM(k.end-k.start) AS cumulative_kernel_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k JOIN CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r ON k.correlationId=r.correlationId JOIN StringIds s ON r.nameId=s.id GROUP BY 1

kernel_graph_split.sql: SELECT graphNodeId IS NOT NULL AS in_graph,COUNT(*) AS kernels,COUNT(DISTINCT correlationId) AS correlations,SUM(end-start) AS cumulative_kernel_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL GROUP BY 1

graph_creation_metadata.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS creation_events,COUNT(DISTINCT graphNodeId) AS distinct_node_ids,SUM(originalGraphNodeId IS NOT NULL) AS clone_records,MIN(start) AS earliest_ns,MAX(end) AS latest_ns,MIN(end-start) AS min_duration_ns,MAX(end-start) AS max_duration_ns FROM CUDA_GRAPH_NODE_EVENTS

graph_node_nvtx_coverage.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS graph_kernels,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CUDA_GRAPH_NODE_EVENTS n WHERE n.graphNodeId=k.graphNodeId)) AS with_creation_event,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CUDA_GRAPH_NODE_EVENTS g JOIN NVTX_EVENTS n ON n.globalTid=g.globalTid AND n.start<=g.start AND n.end>=g.end WHERE g.graphNodeId=k.graphNodeId)) AS with_creation_time_nvtx FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k WHERE k.graphNodeId IS NOT NULL

graph_runtime_nvtx_parents.sql: SELECT COALESCE(n.text,s.value) AS range_name,COUNT(*) AS graph_runtime_calls FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r JOIN StringIds rn ON rn.id=r.nameId JOIN NVTX_EVENTS n ON n.globalTid=r.globalTid AND n.start<=r.start AND n.end>=r.end LEFT JOIN StringIds s ON n.textId=s.id WHERE rn.value LIKE '%GraphLaunch%' GROUP BY 1

gemv_kv_totals.sql: SELECT s.value AS kernel_name,COUNT(*) AS kernels,SUM(k.end-k.start) AS cumulative_kernel_ns,SUM(k.graphNodeId IS NOT NULL) AS graph_kernels,COUNT(DISTINCT k.correlationId) AS correlations,COUNT(DISTINCT k.graphNodeId) AS graph_node_ids FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k JOIN StringIds s ON k.demangledName=s.id WHERE s.value LIKE '%gemv%' OR s.value LIKE '%store_kv%' GROUP BY 1

module_runtime_nvtx_attribution.sql: SELECT n.text AS range_name,COUNT(*) AS kernels,SUM(k.end-k.start) AS cumulative_kernel_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k JOIN CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r ON r.correlationId=k.correlationId JOIN NVTX_EVENTS n ON n.globalTid=r.globalTid AND n.start<=r.start AND n.end>=r.end WHERE n.text IN ('MHA','MLP','LMHead','Embedding','Sampler') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(k.end-k.start) DESC

non_graph_gemv_nvtx.sql: SELECT ks.value AS kernel_name,COALESCE(n.text,ns.value) AS range_name,COUNT(*) AS kernels,SUM(k.end-k.start) AS cumulative_kernel_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k JOIN StringIds ks ON k.demangledName=ks.id JOIN CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r ON r.correlationId=k.correlationId JOIN NVTX_EVENTS n ON n.globalTid=r.globalTid AND n.start<=r.start AND n.end>=r.end LEFT JOIN StringIds ns ON ns.id=n.textId WHERE ks.value LIKE '%gemvx%' AND k.graphNodeId IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2

kv_nvtx.sql: SELECT n.text AS range_name,COUNT(*) AS kernels,SUM(k.end-k.start) AS cumulative_kernel_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k JOIN CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r ON r.correlationId=k.correlationId JOIN StringIds ks ON k.demangledName=ks.id JOIN NVTX_EVENTS n ON n.globalTid=r.globalTid AND n.start<=r.start AND n.end>=r.end WHERE ks.value LIKE '%store_kv%' AND n.text IN ('MHA','M08_ORIGINAL_GENERATE') GROUP BY 1

confirmed_findings: All 11976 kernels join to a unique CUDA runtime correlation in this single-process, single-device, single-context, single-stream trace.
11408 Graph kernels share 31 cudaGraphLaunch correlations; those runtime events are enclosed only by M08_ORIGINAL_GENERATE.
Graph node creation events are retained, but their negative timestamps precede all retained NVTX ranges. No Graph kernel can be assigned a captured module through creation-time NVTX in this export.
The one non-Graph gemvx int7 occurrence is directly associated with LMHead: 656458 ns. This does not independently assign the other 31 Graph int7 occurrences to that module.
The 3472 gemvx int6 occurrences are all Graph nodes; their 112 node IDs and 31 repeats alone do not establish each model linear role or tensor shape.
28 non-Graph KV kernels join to MHA, totaling 35969 ns; 868 other KV kernels are Graph nodes.
limits: The 43 workload uses decode Graph; these durations must not be copied into any new Eager profile as equivalent measurements.
Existing MHA/MLP/Layer NVTX does not label individual linear operator shape; tensor shape cannot be recovered from these generic template names alone.
NVTX is host range duration and kernel durations are GPU activities; nested ranges are not disjoint buckets and must not be summed without a stated assignment rule.
No CUDA runtime callchain is saved, so missing module context cannot be recovered using that field.
Cumulative kernel time is not generate wall-clock critical-path time or an Amdahl bound.
No new performance measurements, hardware-counter observations, or speedup claim are created by this read-only analysis.
next_observation: A separate observational Eager profile with explicit linear-operation labels and shape metadata can map runtime correlations to exact calls. Record it as a new policy/run, not as decomposition of the old Graph timing.
